start.title: Home Again
start.text:
Nazareth rises in the dawn.
Jesus walks the road of his youth.

choices.text: Boast to the village he is here
Walk beside him in quiet honor
Hurry past, ashamed of the place
choices.feedback: Do not despise the small place.

boast_consequence.title: Be Still
boast_consequence.text:
His glory is not a parade.
Let him be seen as he is.

choices.text: Walk beside him in quiet honor

ashamed_consequence.title: Do Not Hide
ashamed_consequence.text:
Even small towns hold holy ground.
Lift your eyes.

choices.text: Walk beside him in quiet honor

synagogue.title: Sabbath in Nazareth
synagogue.text:
The synagogue is quiet and warm.
He stands to read.

choices.text: Listen with an open heart
Whisper about his family

whisper_consequence.title: Listen First
whisper_consequence.text:
Gossip drowns out the word.
Let it be silent.

choices.text: Listen with an open heart

scroll.title: The Scroll Unrolled
scroll.text:
"The Spirit of the Lord is on me…"
His voice fills the room.

choices.text: Test him — "Prove it now."
Marvel at his gracious words
Walk out before he finishes

test_consequence.title: Do Not Test
test_consequence.text:
Demands silence the word in you.
Receive instead.

choices.text: Marvel at his gracious words

walkout_consequence.title: Stay and Hear
walkout_consequence.text:
What you flee, you cannot learn.
Return and listen.

choices.text: Marvel at his gracious words

doubt.title: A Cold Shadow
doubt.text:
Wonder cools. Eyes narrow.
"Where did this man learn this?"

choices.text: Join the doubting murmur
Hold steady in what you heard

join_consequence.title: Hold On
join_consequence.text:
What stirred you was true.
Do not let it go.

choices.text: Hold steady in what you heard

carpenter.title: Joseph's Son
carpenter.text:
"Is this not the carpenter's son?
We know his brothers."

choices.text: Agree — "He is only one of us."
choices.feedback: Familiarity is not the truth of him.

choices.text: Remember the words, not the name
choices.feedback: You see past what you knew.

choices.text: Mock him for his old trade
choices.feedback: Honor is not given by mocking.

agree_consequence.title: Look Again
agree_consequence.text:
He is more than the boy you knew.
Look with new eyes.

choices.text: Remember the words, not the name

mock_consequence.title: Do Not Mock
mock_consequence.text:
What you mock, you cannot receive.
Be quiet.

choices.text: Remember the words, not the name

rejection.title: They Turn Away
rejection.text:
The room grows cold.
Faces close like shutters.

choices.text: Stay near him as they reject
choices.feedback: You do not leave his side.

choices.text: Slip into the crowd, unseen

slip_consequence.title: Stand With Him
slip_consequence.text:
Loyalty is louder than the crowd.
Return to his side.

choices.text: Stay near him as they reject

explain.title: A Prophet at Home
explain.text:
"No prophet is welcomed
in his own hometown."

choices.text: Argue that they will change
Receive his quiet sorrow

argue_consequence.title: Hear the Sorrow
argue_consequence.text:
What he says is true and aching.
Let it land.

choices.text: Receive his quiet sorrow

leaving.title: The Road Out
leaving.text:
He turns toward the open road.
His steps are slow but sure.

choices.text: Stay behind with the doubters
choices.feedback: Do not stay where faith died.

choices.text: Walk out with him in faith

stay_consequence.title: Follow Him
stay_consequence.text:
Faith walks forward.
Do not stay behind.

choices.text: Walk out with him in faith

ending.title: Familiar Eyes, Closed
ending.text:
Where familiarity blocks the heart,
faith finds a quieter road.
